title: NSIS: Update some target and filenames.
description:
Rename the following build targets, similar to the recent macOS target
name changes:

nsis_package_prep to wireshark_nsis_prep
nsis_package to wireshark_nsis

Rename some NSIS files to reflect that they're specific to Wireshark.
Update the documentation and CI configurations.

notes.body:
added 5 commits
  • 358b5c84...709593ee - 4 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 056fd8a1 - NSIS: Update some target and filenames.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7067/diffs?diff_id=408516015&start_sha=358b5c8401cbef6b4f7e68063d0c677b00d6f49c)
Should the WiX projects also be renamed, e.g. wix_package.vcxproj -> wireshark_wix.vcxproj?
They should, along with portableapps_package -> wireshark_portableapps and rpm-package -> wireshark_rpm. My plan is to make each of the packaging target names <application>_<type>.
